_comment: CLS-GL-DARK / ACCT-F122 — carried coverage gaps for verify-gl-posting-coverage.mjs.
known_gaps IS EMPTY, and that is the finding, not an oversight. Prod has ZERO TMS-native postable
money events without a journal entry. Anything the guard reports is therefore NEW and fails.
WHAT MAY NOT GO IN HERE. QBO-origin rows never belong — under parallel books QuickBooks is the
system of record for cloned history and the posting engine refuses them on purpose. Nor may
draft / proforma / void invoices, nor zero-dollar invoices: the guard's status='sent' AND
total_cents > 0 conditions already express that they are not postable events. An entry here means
recognised money genuinely failed to reach the ledger.
ADDING an entry is a decision to accept real debt. REMOVING one is the goal — fix the posting path
and delete the line, never write a journal entry by hand to make the check pass.

superseded.label: INV-2026-00004
superseded.disposition: RESOLVED — BY DESIGN, not a gap
superseded.reason: First carried as tracked debt on the belief that a sent invoice with no journal entry meant the poster had failed. Live prod read settled it: total_cents 0, subtotal_cents 0, amount_open_cents 0, voided_at NULL, and zero invoice_lines. A $0.00 invoice has no revenue and no receivable, so there is nothing for the ledger to recognise and the poster's refusal (audit accounting.invoice.gl_post_failed / INVOICE_LINE_REVENUE_UNRESOLVED, 2026-08-04 22:58:26Z) was CORRECT. Both original hypotheses were refuted on evidence: the flag was ON (INVOICE_AR_GL_POSTING_ENABLED true for USMCA since 2026-07-26, nine days earlier), and the poster did not error on the #4194 date cast — it declined for a stated reason and recorded it. Owner confirmed it as a $0.00 owner-test invoice, void pending via CC-3. The guard now expresses this structurally (total_cents > 0), so no zero-value invoice is ever counted as a gap and no exclusion entry is needed. Kept here rather than deleted: the investigation is the audit trail.
